headline: Nigeria Pushes Non-Oil Exports to $6.1 Billion Amid Economic Reforms
summary: Nigeria's federal government reported non-oil exports reached $6.1 billion, as authorities promote production-driven growth to stabilize foreign exchange and external reserves.
why: Diversification beyond crude oil is crucial for Nigeria's fiscal solvency, foreign exchange reserves, and naira stabilization.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: Expansion of non-oil exports to $6.1 billion provides FX inflows to alleviate currency pressures.
